title: r1 major QE: cannot-run predicate undecidable on a truncated report; timeout-with-partial-report unclassified
description: Evidence: gate-data.md:22-25. A first-test hard abort can truncate the report mid-write — neither 'no report at all' nor 'a populated report'; the discriminator has no verdict where its one job is discrimination. Timeout with a large partial report (900 pass, hang at 901) is likewise unclassified. Runner-dependence noted (process-per-test vs in-process). Disposition: third arm — present-but-unparseable fails closed to cannot-run; extend timeout semantics; bind the verdict to the declared runner's report contract. Data-side fix. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: quality-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, gate-data 0.2.0): cannot_run_when gains the third arm — a report the declared runner's contract cannot parse fails closed to cannot-run (truncated mid-write covered); timeout_semantics covers the partial-report case (a partial report from an unfinished run is not a population); new report_binding field binds the verdict to the declared runner's report contract and states process-model independence. Round 2 re-verifies (validator: quality-engineer).
